indexes.indexdef: CREATE INDEX idx_intake_addresses_company ON public.intake_addresses USING btree (company_code, status)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_intake_addresses_local_active ON public.intake_addresses USING btree (lower(local_part), lower(COALESCE(domain, ''::text))) WHERE (status = 'active'::text)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX intake_addresses_pkey ON public.intake_addresses USING btree (intake_id)
